verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.sprinto.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured docs index. A second probe confirms markdown versions of doc pages that point back to llms.txt, and many cited pages are served as .md with per-page summaries drawn from llms.txt. This gives an agent a ready entry point and machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance, and no independent or hands-on report of agents actually consuming these docs.
